\section[(dialogue)]{The house, weather and feelings — a first pass}

\label{lesson:HI-R192-first-pass-the-house-weather-and-feelings}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for often and never.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a floor, a key, a cupboard, a mirror, rain
  \item sunshine, cold, heat, a storm, a leaf
  \item anger, love, shame, hope, a memory
  \item a church, a police station, a postman, the cinema, a park
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A floor? (\textbf{\hi{फ़र्श}}, \emph{farś}.) A key? (\textbf{\hi{चाबी}}, \emph{cābī}.) A cupboard? (\textbf{\hi{अलमारी}}, \emph{almārī}.) A mirror? (\textbf{\hi{आईना}}, \emph{āīnā}.) Rain? (\textbf{\hi{बारिश}}, \emph{bāriś}.) Sunshine? (\textbf{\hi{धूप}}, \emph{dhūp}.) Cold? (\textbf{\hi{ठंड}}, \emph{ṭhaṇḍ}.) Heat? (\textbf{\hi{गर्मी}}, \emph{garmī}.) A storm? (\textbf{\hi{तूफ़ान}}, \emph{tūfān}.) A leaf? (\textbf{\hi{पत्ता}}, \emph{pattā}.) Anger? (\textbf{\hi{ग़ुस्सा}}, \emph{ġussā}.) Love? (\textbf{\hi{प्यार}}, \emph{pyār}.) Shame? (\textbf{\hi{शर्म}}, \emph{śarm}.) Hope? (\textbf{\hi{उम्मीद}}, \emph{ummīd}.) A memory? (\textbf{\hi{याद}}, \emph{yād}.) A church? (\textbf{\hi{गिरजाघर}}, \emph{girjāghar}.) A police station? (\textbf{\hi{थाना}}, \emph{thānā}.) A postman? (\textbf{\hi{डाकिया}}, \emph{ḍākiyā}.) The cinema? (\textbf{\hi{सिनेमा}}, \emph{sinemā}.) A park? (\textbf{\hi{पार्क}}, \emph{pārk}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Town, talk and time — a second pass}

\label{lesson:HI-R192-second-pass-town-talk-and-time}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a button and a pocket.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a button, a pocket, an enemy, an aunt, a nephew
  \item a letter, a story, a question, an answer, a mistake
  \item help, news, a newspaper, a thing, a colour
  \item a week, a year, a century, a moment, a minute
  \item every day, sometimes, always, often, never
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A button? (\textbf{\hi{बटन}}, \emph{baṭan}.) A pocket? (\textbf{\hi{जेब}}, \emph{jeb}.) An enemy? (\textbf{\hi{दुश्मन}}, \emph{duśman}.) An aunt? (\textbf{\hi{चाची}}, \emph{cācī}.) A nephew? (\textbf{\hi{भतीजा}}, \emph{bhatījā}.) A letter? (\textbf{\hi{चिट्ठी}}, \emph{ciṭṭhī}.) A story? (\textbf{\hi{कहानी}}, \emph{kahānī}.) A question? (\textbf{\hi{सवाल}}, \emph{savāl}.) An answer? (\textbf{\hi{जवाब}}, \emph{javāb}.) A mistake? (\textbf{\hi{ग़लती}}, \emph{ġaltī}.) Help? (\textbf{\hi{मदद}}, \emph{madad}.) News? (\textbf{\hi{ख़बर}}, \emph{khabar}.) A newspaper? (\textbf{\hi{अख़बार}}, \emph{akhbār}.) A thing? (\textbf{\hi{चीज़}}, \emph{cīz}.) A colour? (\textbf{\hi{रंग}}, \emph{raṅg}.) A week? (\textbf{\hi{हफ़्ता}}, \emph{haftā}.) A year? (\textbf{\hi{साल}}, \emph{sāl}.) A century? (\textbf{\hi{सदी}}, \emph{sadī}.) A moment? (\textbf{\hi{पल}}, \emph{pal}.) A minute? (\textbf{\hi{मिनट}}, \emph{miniṭ}.) Every day? (\textbf{\hi{रोज़}}, \emph{roz}.) Sometimes? (\textbf{\hi{कभी}}, \emph{kabhī}.) Always? (\textbf{\hi{हमेशा}}, \emph{hameśā}.) Often? (\textbf{\hi{अक्सर}}, \emph{aksar}.) Never? (\textbf{\hi{कभी} \hi{नहीं}}, \emph{kabhī nahī̃}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
